title: First Light
description: The tail of a serpent, drawn in the sky at the smallest size a node can be --
sixteen pixels -- with `iconScale: 1.0` so the icon fills it corner to corner.
Positions here are free integers. The editor snaps to a 32-pixel grid as a
convenience and nothing enforces it, so this chapter is a drawing made of
coordinates: a spine that bends twice, two short branches, and a moon.
The theme is 'end', which is a dark sky with pale stars in it. It covers this
canvas and the quest panel and stops at the sidebar, which keeps whatever theme
